Your morning deal review.

New incentives, changed terms, approaching deadlines, and evidence that needs a closer look.

Scheduled each morning around 8 a.m. Eastern. Completed findings appear here, with a summary in ChatGPT.

Last completed research: 2026-10-07

Lennar launched a Charlotte Fall Super Sale with a 3.990% FHA 5/1 ARM (7.053% APR) and a separate $7,500 closing-cost offer for contracts signed October 5–11 and closings by November 24 through Lennar Mortgage. Three Pulte claims that are no longer present on current official pages—Cannon Run's 3.99% ARM, Mallard Park's $20,000 choice incentive and Parkside Crossing's $50,000 listing savings—were removed from the live comparison. Pulte's October 25 quick-move-in extras and $2,000 Hometown Heroes savings remain. Smith Douglas, Mattamy, M/I, David Weekley, Eastwood, Meritage, True Homes and DRB terms and current community statuses were rechecked; no additional map-status changes were found.

These are public-source research findings for review. Adding a finding here does not update the main offer comparison.

Lennar

Fall Super Sale · select greater-Charlotte homes

3.990% FHA 5/1 ARM · 7.053% APR · $7,500 closing costs

Lennar's current Fall Super Sale advertises a 3.990% FHA 5/1 adjustable-rate mortgage with a 7.053% APR on select greater-Charlotte homes. The rate is fixed for the first five years and may adjust annually beginning in year six. A separate $7,500 closing-cost contribution is also advertised. Both offers require financing through Lennar Mortgage, LLC, a purchase agreement signed October 5–11, 2026 and closing by November 24, 2026. The official page does not publish a minimum credit score, down payment, complete eligible-address list or stacking rule; those terms remain unavailable rather than inferred.

M/I Homes

Game Time · participating Charlotte communities

5.25% FHA fixed · 6.039% APR · up to 4% closing costs

M/I Homes offers a 5.25% rate with a 6.039% APR on a 30-year fixed FHA mortgage through M/I Financial. The published example assumes a $350,000 price, $337,750 base loan, $343,660 financed amount including the FHA upfront mortgage-insurance premium, 3.5% down and a minimum 640 FICO. The home must be owner occupied, the buyer must apply within 48 hours, sign by October 11 and close by December 31. A separate incentive provides up to 4% of the base price toward allowable closing costs, prepaids, points, rate-lock extensions, a buydown, HOA dues or capital contribution; it cannot reduce the price and lender contribution caps apply.

M/I Homes

Game Time · participating Charlotte communities

4.875% Conventional 7/6 ARM · 5.763% APR

M/I Homes offers a 4.875% initial rate with a 5.763% APR on a 30-year Conventional 7/6 ARM through M/I Financial with 20% down. The rate is fixed for seven years; after 84 payments, the first adjustment is capped at five percentage points and later six-month adjustments at one point, with a 2.75% floor, 9.875% lifetime cap and SOFR plus a 2.75% margin. The home must be owner occupied, the buyer must apply within 48 hours, sign by October 11 and close by November 30. A separate up-to-4% closing-cost incentive is also published, subject to lender caps and allowed uses.

Select Charlotte-area quick move-in homes

Up to $25,000 home discount or financing incentive

David Weekley offers up to $25,000 on select Charlotte-area quick move-in homes for purchase agreements signed October 1–31, 2026 and closings completed by November 30.
